themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI systems that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and execute actions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, acting as collaborators in the development process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI applications designed to aid in information retrieval, analysis, and synthesis for research purposes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI tools and techniques are being integrated into the design and user research workflows to enhance creativity, efficiency, and insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Deals with AI-generated or simulated user profiles, data, or interactions used for testing, training, or research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into shorter, more digestible summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Focuses on articles that compare and evaluate different AI tools specifically for research-related tasks.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that review, benchmark, or analyze the effectiveness and capabilities of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use, impact, and perception of AI chatbots in various contexts, including user interaction and research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and employment landscapes within different industries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
